The addition of `flush_work` in `core.c` ensures that any ongoing work is completed before proceeding with the interface deletion. 

In `pmsr.c`, the refactoring of the work function into a separate processing function allows for direct handling of the abort logic while maintaining proper locking mechanisms. This change prevents the deadlock by ensuring that the work is processed in a controlled manner without relying on the worker mechanism that could lead to holding the lock incorrectly. 

Overall, the changes work together to improve the locking strategy during interface destruction and prevent potential deadlocks in the peer measurement system.
